top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rise on Nvidia, Treasuries Slip: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures advanced as Nvidia Corp.’s bullish sales outlook reinforced optimism that this year’s artificial intelligence rally has further to run. Treasuries edged lower as traders slightly increased bets on interest-rate hikes.
